story: User-reported UX fixes after admin login: attendance proposal rows must disappear after confirmation; mobile schedule header must stop blocking day/week tabs; consult applications need a hold tab for long-waiting applicants.
notes: Attendance proposal panel now shows displayed/total count and explicit immediate-removal copy.
Batch confirmation acts on the rendered proposal set and reports whether more proposals remain.
Mobile schedule removes duplicate topbar schedule metadata and moves active/unassigned summary into a compact content row.
Consult cards can move between 대기 and 보류; held consults are excluded from schedule slots and bulk SMS.
